title: VIRAL Food Festival, Mornington 2026
summary: More than 50 trending street-food dishes, carnival rides, live wrestling, DJs and market stalls at Mornington Racecourse across the 18 to 20 September weekend.
bookingRequired: Tickets available online or at the gate, subject to availability
suitableFor: Families, groups and food-focused weekend plans
verificationNote: On 16 September 2026, the organiser page confirmed Mornington Racecourse and 18 to 20 September. TryBooking confirmed the dates, 330 Racecourse Road, Friday 5pm to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday noon to 10pm, and early-bird and event-day entry terms. Melbourne Insider independently listed the Mornington event and ticket destination.
editorVerdict: This is the big, busy option for a group that wants food, rides and a full afternoon in one place. Go Friday if you want the shortest queues.
editorNote:
VIRAL Food Festival reaches Mornington Racecourse for its first Mornington run from Friday 18 September to Sunday 20 September. The organiser promises more than 50 trending street-food dishes, while the ticket page adds live DJs, wrestling, stage games, creators, carnival rides and games.

Friday runs from 5pm to 10pm. Saturday and Sunday run from noon to 10pm. Tickets are sold through TryBooking, and the organiser's early-entry offer ends Thursday 17 September. Check the ticket page before leaving, because entry terms and availability can change.

The useful call is simple: make this the main event, not a stop between bookings. The racecourse is at 330 Racecourse Road in Mornington, so leave time for the food lines and the carnival if children are coming.
